title: Pirate plunder video (Vidéo de Pillage du Pirate)
names_seen: Pirate plunder video (Vidéo de Pillage du Pirate)

facts.statement: freerealms.com posted a French-language news item with a video of a pirate plunder ('pillage du pirate') showcasing what was new in Free Realms.
facts.quote: Regarder cette vidéo de pillage du pirate est de quoi il s'agit!

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: This is a short French-language freerealms.com news post (listed as 'Vidéo de Pillage du Pirate!') that links a video showing the pirate plunder feature and invites players to see what is new in Free Realms. It gives no mechanics, numbers, quests or rewards, so it is of little use beyond confirming that a pirate plunder video existed in the live game's news archive.
